chains.title: CEBPA binds the alt T allele and activates SORT1 in hepatocytes

links.claim: The alt T allele at rs12740374 binds CEBPA more strongly than the ref G allele.
rs12740374 lies in a hepatocyte-active enhancer-like element whose activity is higher on the T allele.
The rs12740374 enhancer regulates SORT1 expression, with the T allele increasing SORT1 in hepatocytes.
The effect is operative in hepatocytes, consistent with Hep3B2.1-7 expression context.
Altered hepatocyte SORT1 expression changes plasma LDL cholesterol and myocardial infarction risk.

predictions: Alt T allele binds CEBPA more strongly than ref G at rs12740374 in Hep3B.
The rs12740374 T allele increases enhancer/reporter activity in hepatocytes.
T-allele increased CEBPA binding increases SORT1 expression in hepatocytes.
CEBPA knockdown reduces T-allele reporter activity and SORT1 expression in Hep3B.
falsified_if: CEBPA does not bind the T allele more than G in Hep3B.
CEBPA knockdown does not reduce T-allele reporter activity or SORT1 expression.

chains.title: Null: no TF-mediated effect of rs12740374
predictions: No allele-specific TF binding at rs12740374.
No allele-specific enhancer activity attributable to rs12740374.
Any SORT1/LDL/MI association is due to a linked causal variant or another mechanism.
falsified_if: Allele-specific C/EBP binding and an rs12740374-dependent enhancer/SORT1 effect are demonstrated.
